reviewer_role: AI artifact reviewer (Codex subagent /root/citation_audit); not a human peer reviewer or qualified clinical expert

scope.manuscript: Journal, abstract through first two software-scope table rows

method: Individually read all 220 indexed units in their surrounding draft context; compared formulas, table values, implementation paths, executed receipts and recorded primary-source citation checks. Dispositions are manual AI artifact assessments, not inherited section labels or automatic test-to-science promotion. No new live provider, cloud test, training or complete fresh primary-source audit was performed during this individual pass.
interpretation: Reproduced is restricted to the named artifact count/calculation/designed software scenario. Definitions and table headers are assessed as contextual notation, not independent empirical findings. No unsupported category was manufactured simply to force all six categories to appear.
